title: Linear time mixing and pre-cutoff for oriented kinetically constrained models
summary: We establish linear time precutoff for oriented kinetically constrained models (KCMs) on a $d$-dimensional box of side length $n$, whenever the finite-volume spectral gap is bounded away from zero uniformly in $n$. A typical example is the North-East model, a $0$-$1$ spin system on the two-dimensional integer lattice that evolves according to the following rule: whenever a site's southerly and westerly nearest neighbours have spin $0$, with rate one it resets its own spin by tossing a $(1-q)$-coin; at all other times its spin remains frozen.
